Fix `packages/element/src/bounds.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Bug in getLinearElementRotatedBoundsWithHeads (bounds.ts:1275-1280): `element.endArrowhead ?? "arrow"` turns an explicit `endArrowhead: null` (no end head) into a phantom "arrow" head, so a large arrow with NO heads grows its bounds. Measured with getElementBounds on an arrow points [[0,0],[100,0]], startArrowhead null, endArrowhead null: no size gives y-range [-0.08, 0.65]; arrowheadSize "large" gives [-12.54, 13.11], though nothing extra is drawn. shape.ts (around line 998) reads `const { startArrowhead = null, endArrowhead = "arrow" } = element;`, a destructuring default that applies only to undefined. Fix: make the bounds code read the heads exactly as shape.ts does (e.g. the same destructuring default, or `element.endArrowhead === undefined ? "arrow" : element.endArrowhead`), so null means no head. Change nothing else in the file.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.
